title: Thai Crispy Bread Casserole
description: A unique twist on a classic casserole, blending Thai flavors with crunchy Russian bread. Perfect for a satisfying snack or light meal.
instructions: Cut the old fashioned crunchy bread and Russian white bread into 1-inch cubes.
In a large skillet, heat the vegetable oil over medium heat. Add the onion and garlic and cook until softened, about 3-4 minutes.
In a large bowl, whisk together the fish sauce, soy sauce, sugar, eggs, and coconut milk.
Add the cooked onion and garlic mixture to the bowl and stir to combine.
Add the bread cubes to the bowl and toss until the bread is well coated with the egg mixture.
Transfer the bread mixture to a 9x13-inch baking dish.
Bake the casserole for 25-30 minutes, or until the top is golden brown and the casserole is set.
Remove the casserole from the oven and let it cool for a few minutes before serving.
